title: Research: distinguish P112 query self-cost from actual reader cost
body:
## Summary

```diff
 fixed PR3370 rank-32 matrix K, complete-plane tariff
  32 literal queries:                         actual bill 224
+ 38 external queries: source self-Gram 218,   actual reader bill 244
+ one-binary-seed seven-direction family:     cannot lower the actual bill
```

This source-bound boundary audit answers the outside-rowspace handoff in [PR3383](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3383). The exact 38-query identity works over every field, but its actual readers reject the proposed saving. The proof covers all 496 literal query pairs and all 28 unimodular canonical bases. The sole determinant-two basis has a separate reader-rank bound and requires characteristic other than two. Arbitrary rational directions and multiple external dimensions remain open.

Only `research/plane-query-reader-boundary/` is added. The coverage-law card is explicitly changed to this scoped audit. Credit Tekalign/PR3370, PR3383, PR3345, Philippe Van Velzen's retained integral floor and the full predecessor lineage in the package.

## Evidence

- Before: source self-Gram charges alone suggested 218. After: all 12,544 integer UQ=K entries pass, while actual rectangular charges total 244 against the literal 224 baseline.
- Primary replay checks 11,392 forced mask entries, 50,176 expanded binary entries, 35 formal triples, 496 pair bounds and every term's two closures. A separate no-import sparse/dense checker agrees and checks all 224 source/additive-dirty-target columns.
- Seven behavioral groups include four optimized actual-CLI mutations. Registered Python 3.12.15 replay, Ruff diagnostics, source-history/committed-byte checks and the unchanged Git-free committed export pass. Direct export checks also pass on Python 3.15.
- Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/plane-query-reader-boundary`. Standard library only. The exact PR3370 certificate is retained; no pending Git object is required.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. One isolated research package.

Blast radius: package. This proves a scoped algebraic obstruction and records a failed saving. It supplies no native execution, physical restoration/hosting/precision bill, supplier admission, all-size theorem, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Scientific review and hosted CI remain separate from publication.
